title: Norwegian Fish Casserole
description: A rich and satisfying casserole dish that combines the flavors of Norway with the freshness of fish.

ingredients.name: Fish fillet
ingredients.notes: Fresh cod or salmon works well

ingredients.name: Norwegian cheese
ingredients.notes: Gjetost or Jarlsberg are good options

ingredients.name: Casserole dish
ingredients.notes: To assemble and bake the casserole

instructions: Season the fish with salt, pepper, and any other desired herbs.
In a saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly pour in the cream, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until thickened.
Stir in the Norwegian cheese until melted and smooth.
In a separate pan, cook the fish fillet until cooked through.
Cut the cooked fish into large pieces and add to the cheese sauce.
Transfer the fish and cheese mixture to the casserole dish.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, until the top is golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
